messages:
mina: Heads-up: rolling a slim base-image rebuild Weds 06:45 PT. Goals: drop CAP_NET_RAW/CAP_SYS_ADMIN where not required, enforce non-root user, enable userns remap, and switch keystore-operator to per-cluster KMS aliases.

torey: Sounds good. Are we doing a single-shot flip or a staged canary?

mina: Staged. dev-canary -> staging -> prod-canary -> rest. 12m windows with automated checks (vuln-scan + signature validation).

felix: RBAC pre-reqs: bake-runner SA still has cluster-admin in legacy-ns. Ill open a migration PR that limits to Job.create, Pod.create and exec where needed. We'll add an audit tag on the Role/Binding for SOC.

sam: What key naming pattern for KMS? per-cluster alias or versions on one key?

mina: Per-cluster alias: projects/redwood/keys/keystore-<cluster>. Keeps revoke/scope simple. infra will pre-create them and grant operator kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt.

felix: Incident runbook question: if rewrap fails during rollout, fallback path?

mina: Fallback: decrypt with previous KEK and rewrap, or short-term rollback to the old image + old operator in cold standby. I'll put explicit gcloud commands in the runbook.

sec-bot: ticket SEC-9027 created: base-image slim + per-cluster keystore + RBAC audit.

felix: SOC asked for immutable audit retention 1y. If logs are KMS-encrypted, how do we prove immutability?

mina: Plan: logs go to a WORM-enforced bucket; each upload gets a signed manifest (cosign) that lists image tag, key alias used, and SBOM checksum. Manifest stored alongside logs and signed with our cosign key.

sam: Build pipeline changes: produce SBOM (cyclonedx), sign SBOM with cosign, and attach attestation. Also set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in Docker build to reduce nondeterminism.

felix: RBAC PR should annotate objects with `sec.redwood/audit=SEC-9027` so SOC can reconcile changes.

mina: Agreed. Also removing any `system:masters` bindings from bake-runner before we flip.

sam: Preflight checks for rollout team:
```
# confirm capabilities dropped in running pods
kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop}' | grep NET_RAW && echo BAD || echo OK
# verify cosign signature for candidate image
cosign verify --bundle -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign registry.redwood/base:sha
# verify userns support
grep -q userns /proc/filesystems || echo userns-missing
```

felix: Monitoring/alerts: add alert to page if >3 failed rewrap attempts in 5m or if promoted tag fails cosign verify. That should trigger incident runbook attach to SEC-9027.

mina: Rollback plan: re-tag previous image as fallback, and keep previous operator image in a paused deployment ready to unpause.

torey: Edge-case: legacy pcap debug helper still needs NET_RAW. Plan: move it out to a restricted debug daemonset on a tainted nodepool instead of granting capabilities to app pods.

mina: Good call. Include nodeAffinity + taint in infra PR.

sec-bot: rollout-checklist: [ ] RBAC migration PR merged & annotated, [ ] per-cluster KMS aliases provisioned, [ ] cosign signer rotated & tested, [ ] SBOM + attestation pipeline green, [ ] canary windows scheduled, [ ] runbook attached to SEC-9027.

felix: I'll own RBAC PR and pair with mina at 3pm. Torey you take KMS provisioning?

torey: Yep, infra will provision and run an access-check CI job. ETA EOD today.

mina: I'll draft the runbook with explicit recover steps and gcloud examples, and cc SOC/legal on SEC-9027. Posting 30m heads-up in #release-war-room before starting. :lock:
